verses.verse:
ममापि कृष्णे भक्तिः स्यादिति वंशीम् भजाम्यहम्।
साधना चास्य वाद्यस्य धर्मार्थादि फलप्रदा।।४।।
verses.text: Thinking 'may I too have devotion to Kṛṣṇa', I worship the bānsurī; and practice of this instrument bestows the fruits beginning with dharma and artha (the four aims of life).

commentary.text: Thinking 'may I too have bhakti (devotion) for Śrī Kṛṣṇa', I worship the bānsurī, because through its sādhanā (practice) the four fruits, dharma, artha, kāma and mokṣa, are obtained.
